environment.description: Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal CLI deployment. The tool is compiled with gcc -O2 (no sanitizers, no hardened malloc). It connects directly to PostgreSQL 15 on localhost:5432. Input files are user-supplied via a shared upload directory (/var/spool/cli-jobs/). The process runs as 'app' user with standard glibc malloc. No ASLR entropy increase beyond default. Attacker can craft input files with 'D'-prefixed lines to trigger the double-free, then heap-spray via subsequent allocations to achieve code execution.

config.aslr: default (8-bit entropy on 32-bit, limited on stack)
